contract.name: Winter 2026/27 travel agent contracted rates – Select Hotels (revised)
contract.hotel_reference: Select Hotels – Travel Agent Contracted Rates – Winter 2026/2027 (Revised)
contract.tax_note: USD nett, non-commissionable. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes the hotel may add them from the date of implementation.
contract.guide_policy_text: Driver Accommodation – Not Available (no guide accommodation terms printed).
contract.cancellation_text: Cancellations within 07 days of the arrival date – 100% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 14 days of the arrival date – 50% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 21 days of the arrival date – 25% of the value of the booking. Group bookings, more than 8 rooms, will be liable to pay 50% of the basis booked before 30 days of arrival. For the periods of 26th Dec 2026 to 10th Jan 2027 & Feb 2027 Cancellations Before 28 days of arrival date – 50% of the value of the booking and Cancellations within 28 days of the arrival date – 100% of the value of the booking. This will apply to credit or non-credit agents. (Only Applicable for Mermaid Hotel & Club)
contract.payment_text: Travel agents without credit facilities are required to make the relevant payment 05 days before the clients check into the hotel. Travel agents that are entitled to credit facilities should make necessary payments within one month of the departure of guests. For last minute/short notice bookings, 100% of the payment is to be made on confirmation. For the periods of 26th Dec 2026 to 10th Jan 2027 & Feb 2027 50% of the payment is to be made on confirmation. This will apply to credit or non-credit agents. (Only Applicable for Mermaid Hotel & Club)
contract.terms_text: MERMAID HOTEL & CLUB: Single Reduction – USD 20 / Triple Supplement (Not applicable for Sea View category) – USD 50 (On HB). Single Reduction – USD 20 / Triple Supplement (Not applicable for Sea View category) – USD 100 (On AI). Driver Accommodation - Not Available. Reservations +94 34 720 0478, resv@mermaidhotelnclub.com. | RATES: Rates are in USD and are non-commissionable. The accommodation rates are not valid for Meetings/Incentives/Conferences/Events/Exhibitions/Weddings. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes, the hotel reserves the right to add such taxes to the rates from the date of implementation. Rates cannot be extended to the domestic market or any other unspecified markets. Rates should not be published as hotel only rate on the internet by you or any other 3rd party. If such case occurs, the hotel has the right to withdraw the rate with immediate effect. | CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT: Check-in time is 14:00 and check-out time is 12:00 (noon). If an early check-in is required within 04 hours of the usual check-in time, 50% charge of the room rate will be applied. For late check-outs up to 04 hours past the original check-out time, a 50% room rate charge will apply. Late check outs past 04 hours will be charged for 100% room rate.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Jetwing Hotels - Select Hotels - TA Contracted Rates - Winter 2026-2027 (Revised).pdf" (8 pages), saved to the HOTEL RATES folder on 2 Oct 2026. Currency "USD Nett (Per room/Per night)", occupancy "Double Occupancy": the printed figure is the room at double occupancy. Market list: "Rates cannot be extended to the domestic market or any other unspecified markets" → DOM excluded. No contract date, gala dinner or guide rate is printed. No supplier record in the live system yet. Feb 2027 is printed as its own period (same figures as the 26 Dec – 10 Jan peak) and carries the Mermaid-only peak cancellation (50% before / 100% within 28 days) and payment (50% on confirmation) terms. Triple left blank for Sea View, Premium Sea View and Premium Deluxe Sea View: the sheet says the triple supplement and the child-with-extra-bed rate are "Not applicable for Sea View category" (read as every sea-view column — confirm).
contract.child_policy_text: Child Policy (Maximum Up to 02 Children): Age of 0-5 Free of Charge. Age of 6-11.99: USD 35 (Per kid/Per night on HB including extra bed), USD 48 (Per kid/Per night on AI including extra bed) (Not applicable for Sea View category & Triple Occupancy); USD 25 (Per kid/Per night on HB excluding extra bed), USD 38 (Per kid/Per night on AI excluding extra bed). Baby cot on request can be provided free of charge. (Up to one cot per room)
contract.source_file: Jetwing Hotels - Select Hotels - TA Contracted Rates - Winter 2026-2027 (Revised).pdf
